svg.title: Wasted energy vs Bitcoin, to scale
svg.desc: Pixel grid where each square represents one terawatt-hour of annual electricity. The wasted-energy block (338.8 TWh/yr, split into 184.5 TWh of curtailed renewables and 154.2 TWh of flared gas) is visibly larger than the Bitcoin-network block (197.6 TWh/yr).
svg.text: ■ 184.5 TWh curtailed renewables (T1 live TSO) ■ 154.2 TWh flared gas (T2-flare basins)
■ 197.6 TWh global network consumption (WooCharts ESG tracker)
